result.reason: The operative addition reaches the preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Licensee Data within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and certified deletion thereafter. It leaves the existing termination obligations intact. However, the added prohibition on withholding or suspending data access goes beyond the stated playbook requirement and makes the revision less than strictly minimal. Drafting is generally professional, though the scope of “Licensee Data” is broad and the automatic termination of all licenses could create some uncertainty if continued access is needed for transition assistance.
